## Checklist

- [ ] I launched the pack and checked the change in game
- [ ] Mod changes are recorded in `packwiz/` (side set, `packwiz refresh` run) and the config files for the mod are included
- [ ] If a mod was added, I started the server (or marked it client-only)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for this change
- [ ] No worlds, logs, screenshots or account data are included
